company.description:
ChartHop is an information technology company that specializes in the fields of software development and management. ChartHop is designed to be used by the whole organization. This helps companies improve organizational health, drive alignment and accountability, and save time and money.

It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New York, United States.
